summary: testSettingsAnalyticsPreferenceStopsReportingAndPersistsBothStates constructs fresh AnalyticsService instances against the same real UserDefaults suite to model a relaunch, and asserts the disabled and re-enabled preference is correctly read back (isEnabled false then true) — a genuine, non-tautological, non-mocked persistence check that would fail if the preference weren't written/read via the injected UserDefaults.
